attacks.name: Symbiote Tendrils
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: Maximum Carnage
steps: After each attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.
|!wild| |!hit| |*Rampage|: After each attack is resolved, deal 1 |!damage| to each other enemy character within |!range| 2 of this character.

superPowers.name: Sadistic Glee
superPowers.body: During the next attack action made by this character this turn, add 2 dice to its attack rolls. After each attack is resolved, if the attack roll contains any |!failure| results this character suffers 1 |!damage|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Paint The Town Red
superPowers.body: If this character Dazes or KO's an enemy character with an attack during its Activation, after this attack is resolved, this character may use this superpower. This character removes all |!damage| from itself, Advances |!range_small|, makes a |*Symbiote Tendrils| attack, and adds 2 dice to that attack roll. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Arch Nemesis [Eddie Brock]
superPowers.body: When attacking |*Eddie Brock|, this character may modify or reroll |!failure| results and may reroll any number of attack dice. At the start of this character's Activation, if there is a non-Dazed enemy |*Eddie Brock| within |!range| 3 of this character, this character's first action must be an attack action targeting that |*Eddie Brock|, if possible.

superPowers.name: Symbiotic Serial Killer
superPowers.body: When this character is attacking, the defending character does not add dice to its defense roll for |!critical| results.
